decisive_items: mild leukocytosis (23,690/µL; reference 8,700–17,500/µL) with neutrophilia (92.4%; reference 42.4–76.4%)
response.rationale: Warm fluctuant mass with leukocytosis and neutrophilia strongly supports an infectious abscess; hematoma is contradicted by warmth and leukocytosis, and sarcoma lacks inflammatory markers.

rejected.why: No inflammatory or infectious features; mass characteristics are nonspecific and lack supporting evidence.
Warmth and leukocytosis contradict a simple hematoma; no trauma or bleeding history.
